title: Combat core: hits, damage pipeline, kill events
description: The server-authoritative combat core: a weapon-hit resolver that applies damage through the TASK-23 pipeline, combat event broadcasts, and kill/destroy attribution — the shared backbone for lasers, missiles, AI, and PvP.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server/shard/combat.ts: resolveHit(shard, {weapon, sourceId, targetId, damagePoint}): validates (target alive, in range for the weapon, line-of-sight check against terrain for surface-combat — a ship behind a mountain is not hit; space has no LOS), applies TASK-23 applyDamage, emits combat events

Combat events broadcast (TASK-9 'combat_event'): {kind:'hit', target, source, weapon, damage, shieldHit, hullHit}, {kind:'destroyed', target, source, weapon}, {kind:'kill', killer, victim, weapon} (kill = destroyed with a player source) — all clients in the shard receive them (drives HUD, FX, toasts)

Damage attribution is exact: the HUD (TASK-50) can show 'interceptor laser hit your hull for 8' from the event data; a destroyed ship's killer is recorded in the event and (for wrecks) rendered as a skull marker until despawn (TASK-49 consumes it)
Targeting rules: friendly fire is ON in v1 (PvP parity — TASK-47); a ship cannot fire at itself ({code:'self-target'}); destroyed entities are not targetable (TASK-23)
Hit registration is server-side only: the client never computes whether a shot hit — it sends fire intents (TASK-43), the server resolves; a client-side 'I hit' claim is ignored (anti-cheat, TASK-67)

Unit tests: LOS math (terrain occlusion with analytic terrain, space no-LOS), damage pipeline integration (hit → shields → hull → destroyed sequence), event emission (exact payloads), self-target rejection, dead-target rejection; integration: two ships trading hits via the sim, kill event observed by a third client

steps.details: resolveHit as specified; LOS: raycast source→damagePoint against the terrain heightfield (subsampled 5 points; any point below terrain = occluded) — space regime skips LOS entirely. Range per weapon (TASK-43 supplies it).

shard.events emits combat events → broadcast to all conns (same channel as entity_update, distinct msg type). Kill tracking: destroyed event with a player source → kill event; a wreck's killer id stored on the wreck entity (TASK-49).

SimLoop: weapon fire intents (from TASK-43's message) → projectile travel (space: instant ray for lasers, TASK-43; missiles: moving entities, TASK-43) → on contact: resolveHit. This task provides resolveHit + the contact-callback contract; projectiles land in TASK-43.
All listed; the two-ship exchange test drives real ws clients through the sim. Run full suite.

technicalNotes: Friendly fire ON is the PRD's PvP-parity decision: one pipeline for everything. No team flags in v1.
LOS subsampling (5 points) is a deliberate cheap approximation — terrain is smooth (TASK-5 max slope 45°), so 5 samples over ≤ 2 km is sufficient; document the assumption.
